description: This source file contains unit tests for the SessionData component of the OpenClaw project, specifically testing session kind detection, token statistics formatting, usage percentage clamping, and flag label inclusion in session rows.

classes.name: SessionDataTests
classes.description: A struct containing test functions for various aspects of session data handling in OpenClaw.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Test to verify that the session kind detection correctly identifies 'global', 'discord:group:engineering', 'unknown', and email-based keys.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected
methods.description: Test to verify that token counts are correctly formatted into human-readable strings with 'k' notation.

methods.name: session token stats percent used clamps to100
methods.description: Test that the percentUsed property correctly clamps at 100%.

methods.name: session row flag labels include non default flags
methods.description: Test to ensure that session rows correctly include labels for non-default flags such as 'think high', 'verbose debug', 'system sent', and 'aborted'.
